kpis.description: Four measures of how well your asset library is working, for the period you choose and the same number of days before it.
kpis.errorHint: Something went wrong on our side. Your data is safe; try again in a moment.
kpis.periodLine: {{from}} to {{to}} ({{days}} days), compared with {{prevFrom}} to {{prevTo}}. Days are counted in UTC.

publishing.title: Publishing effort
publishing.headline: Median time from creation to first publication
publishing.empty: No assets were published for the first time in this period.
publishing.measured1: For every asset first published in the period we take the hours from when it was created to when it first became published. The headline is the median: half the assets were faster, half slower. The 90th percentile shows how long the slowest tenth took.
publishing.measured2: "Approved first time" is the share that never had an approval task rejected. An asset published without a workflow counts as approved first time. Fewer hours and a higher share are better.

duplicates.title: Duplicate reduction
duplicates.headline: Duplicate uploads recognised and not stored again
duplicates.empty: No uploads finished in this period, so there is no rate yet.
duplicates.caption: {{prevented}} of {{uploads}} finished uploads were already in the library
duplicates.measured1: Of the uploads that finished in the period, we count those recognised as a file the library already holds. They are not stored a second time. The rate is that count divided by all finished uploads, and the storage figure is the size of the files that were not stored again.
duplicates.measured2: "Duplicates still in the library" is a snapshot of today, not of the period: assets whose file another asset also holds, because they were allowed through or arrived before the check existed. More duplicates prevented is better.

reuse.title: Asset reuse
reuse.headline: Used assets that were used more than once
reuse.empty: No assets were used in this period.
reuse.caption: {{reused}} of {{used}} used assets
reuse.multi: Used on two or more channels
reuse.measured1: Among assets with at least one recorded use in the period (a download, share, embed or playback), we count those used at least twice. The headline is that count divided by the assets used at all.
reuse.measured2: Previews and thumbnails are not uses. A higher share means assets are being reused rather than recreated; it is the same data as the usage numbers on the dashboard.

sla.title: Workflow on-time rate
sla.headline: Approval decisions made on or before their due time
sla.empty: No approval tasks with a due time were decided in this period.
sla.caption: {{onTime}} of {{decided}} decisions
sla.breached: Due times missed in the period
sla.measured1: Among approval tasks that had a due time and were decided in the period, we count those decided on or before it. The headline is that count divided by all such decisions.
sla.measured2: "Due times missed" counts tasks whose breach was recorded in the period. "Open tasks overdue right now" is a snapshot of today. A higher on-time share is better.

schedules.title: Scheduled reports
schedules.intro: Email a report to people in this organisation on a schedule. Recipients are people with an account here, never outside addresses, and the email links back to this page where the full report can be downloaded.
schedules.emptyBody: Set one up and the report will arrive by email on the days you choose.
schedules.formIntro: The email shows the first rows of the report and links to this console for the rest. Times are in UTC.
schedules.daysHint: How many days back each email looks, from 1 to {{max}}.
schedules.daysInvalid: Enter a whole number of days from 1 to {{max}}.
schedules.dayOfMonthHint: 1 to 31. In a shorter month the last day is used.
schedules.recipientPlaceholder: Search people by name or email
schedules.recipientsHint: Only people in this organisation can receive a report.
schedules.directoryDenied: Your role can't list people, so names may show as short codes and search may be unavailable.
schedules.enabledHint: A paused schedule keeps its settings but sends nothing.

schedules.deleteBody: {{report}} will no longer be emailed on this schedule. Reports already sent are not affected.
